title: Lapse Allowance Days of a Document Hold: Calculation Sheet for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing: lapse allowance days.**

The lapse allowance days are the calendar days a document hold may run, counted from the hold start date, before it ends in deactivation for document lapse. A document hold still in place on the day its lapse allowance days run out ends in deactivation for document lapse, and the deactivation is dated the hold start date plus the lapse allowance days.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Where it is read | How it enters |
|---|---|---|
| Hold start date | the agreement (hold start date of the document hold in force) | the day the count runs from |
| Standard document hold length of the agreement's level | the level schedule of required documents (document hold length, in days) | the lapse allowance days are this length |
| Lapse allowance days | worked out on this sheet | a whole number of calendar days; no rounding applies |
| Deactivation date | the hold start date plus the lapse allowance days | the date the deactivation carries |

## Method

1. Read the agreement's service level and take the standard document hold length of that level from the level schedule. The lapse allowance days are that length, a whole number of calendar days.
2. Count that many calendar days forward from the hold start date. The day reached is the day the lapse allowance days run out and is the deactivation date.
3. If the document hold is still in place on that day, or on any later day on which the matter is looked at, the hold ends in deactivation for document lapse dated that day.

## Worked example (hypothetical agreement)

- Level: Wayfare Green; the level schedule gives a document hold length of 90 days.
- Hold start date: 2026-03-04.
- Lapse allowance days: 90.
- Counting 90 calendar days from 2026-03-04 reaches 2026-06-02 (27 days to the end of March, 30 in April, 31 in May, 2 in June).
- On 2026-06-01 the lapse allowance days have not run out. On 2026-06-02, or on any later day with the hold still in place, the deactivation for document lapse is dated 2026-06-02.
